title: My English Book 2
header: Builds "My English Book 2" – second-grade English syllabus – A4 portrait.
csub: Days • Body • Food • Clothes • Weather • I can
noteP: هٰذَا الكِتَابُ يُكْمِلُ تَعْلِيمَ الإِنْجِلِيزِيَّة: أَيَّامُ الأُسْبُوع، وَالجِسْم، وَالطَّعَام، وَالمَلَابِس، وَالطَّقْس، وَأَنَا أَسْتَطِيع، وَحُرُوفُ المَكَان، مَعَ قِصَّةٍ قَصِيرَة 🇬🇧
noteLi: اقْرَؤُوا الجُمْلَةَ الإِنْجِلِيزِيَّةَ وَدَعُوا طِفْلَكُم يُكَرِّرُهَا.
اسْأَلُوهُ كُلَّ صَبَاح: What day is it today?
العَبُوا لُعْبَةَ: Where is the cat? بِلُعْبَةٍ وَصُنْدُوق.
الكِتَابُ يُقْرَأُ مِنَ اليَسَارِ إِلَى اليَمِين.
blurb: A complete, colourful 3D English book – part 2, with Arabic meanings for every word.
blurbLi: Days of the week and my body
in, on, under, next to – with a short story

units.title: My Body
units.intro: I use my body to see, hear, smell, talk, hold and walk.
items: I eat and talk with my mouth.
I hold my pencil with my hand.

acts.title: Match
acts.hint: Draw a line to the word ✏️

units.title: Food
units.intro: I eat healthy food every day.

units.title: Clothes
units.intro: I wear clean clothes every day.
items: My sister has a pink dress.
I wear a coat in winter.

units.title: The Weather
units.intro: What is the weather like today?
items: It is sunny and hot today.
It is rainy. Take an umbrella!
It is windy. Let's fly a kite!
It is snowy and very cold.

units.title: I Can …
units.intro: I can do many things. What can you do?
items: I can swim in the sea.

units.title: Where Is It?
units.intro: in, on, under, next to: where is the cat?
items: The cat is in the box.
The cat is on the box.
The cat is under the table.
The cat is next to the box.

acts.title: Read the Story
acts.html:
Sam and His Cat 🐱

This is Sam. Sam has a little cat.
The cat is in the box.
Now the cat is on the bed!
Where is the cat now?
It is under the table. Silly cat!
